lede: Use the BabyQuip promo code {code} for {pct} off at BabyQuip, the baby gear rental marketplace that delivers cribs, strollers and car seats to your hotel, vacation rental or airport. Here's what the gear costs to rent, the fees on top, and how to pay less.

sections.h2: What BabyQuip gear costs with the code
parts: BabyQuip isn't one store with one price list. Gear is rented from independent local providers, called Quality Providers, who set their own daily rates and delivery fees. These were the lowest daily rates BabyQuip showed for Orlando, one of its busiest cities:

parts.small: Lowest Orlando rates shown on babyquip.com on November 11, 2026, before delivery, fees and taxes. The price with the code assumes the code applies to the rental.

parts: On top of the rental, you pay the provider's delivery fee and BabyQuip's service fee of 6 to 9%, worked out on the rental and delivery subtotal. Your order summary shows both before you pay.
BabyQuip takes money off longer rentals automatically, with no code needed:

list: 1 to 8 days: the standard daily rate

parts: BabyQuip counts every calendar day you have the gear, so Monday evening to the next Monday morning is 8 days. If your trip is 8 days, check whether one extra day moves you into the 10% tier: a crib from $14 a day costs $112 for 8 days and $113.40 for 9 days with 10% off.

Delivery, setup and pickup are included in the delivery fee, which each provider sets by distance and area. Some providers offer self-pickup and self-return instead: you collect the gear from their address and bring it back. If you have a car and time, it can save the delivery fee. Look for providers that offer it before you book, and note that a full-size folding crib doesn't fit in every car.
Airport deliveries, same-day deliveries, after-hours drop-offs and holiday deliveries can cost extra with some providers.

If a provider has to come back, for example because you add gear after the first delivery, there's an extra trip fee. Add the crib, stroller, high chair and anything else to the same reservation, with the same provider, so you pay one delivery fee.

sections.h2: 4. Know the cancellation rules before you pay
parts: BabyQuip takes full payment when you book. What you get back if plans change depends on when you cancel:

list: Within 24 hours of booking, and 48 hours or more before the start: a full refund, minus the service fee.
15 days or more before the start: the rental fees are refunded, minus the service fee.
Less than 15 days before the start: rental fees aren't refunded, but delivery fees, surcharges and prepaid tips are.
Orders made less than 24 hours before the start: no refund.

parts: Cancel For Any Reason is an optional add-on for reservations with US providers. With it, you can cancel up to the start time and get your rental and service fees back, minus the cost of the add-on. It can't be added within 48 hours of the start.

list: Minimum rental: usually 3 days. Some providers allow 1 or 2 days if you ask.
Damage: in the US, if gear is damaged, lost or stolen and the provider files a claim, you pay a $25 minor damage charge and BabyQuip covers accidental damage up to $1,000.
Cleaning: gear returned with vomit, smoke or heavy stains can cost $25 an item, or full replacement.
Car seats: providers can't install them, for insurance reasons. You get the manual or a link to the instructions.

faq: Is there a BabyQuip promo code?
Yes. Code {code} takes {pct} off at BabyQuip. Enter it at checkout and check the total before you pay.
Is there a BabyQuip discount code or coupon code?

Yes. At BabyQuip a promo code, a discount code and a coupon code are the same thing: code {code} takes {pct} off. You may also see the brand written as Baby Quip: it's the same company and the same code.
Is there a BabyQuip promo code for a first order?
We didn't find a separate first-order code on babyquip.com on November 11, 2026. Code {code} is the one we list. Longer rentals get an automatic discount of 10 to 30% on top.
How much does BabyQuip cost?

It depends on the city and the provider. In Orlando, rates started at $14 a day for a full-size crib, $5 for a single stroller, $8 for a convertible car seat and $4 for a high chair, plus delivery, a 6 to 9% service fee and taxes.
How much is a crib rental at BabyQuip?
From $14 a day in Orlando when we checked, so $98 for 7 days, or $93.10 with code {code} if it applies to the rental. Delivery and fees are extra.
What is the BabyQuip service fee?
Between 6% and 9% of the rental and delivery subtotal, before other fees and taxes. The exact amount shows in your order summary at checkout.
How much does BabyQuip delivery cost?
Each provider sets its own delivery fee by distance and area, and it covers delivery, setup and pickup. Airport, same-day, after-hours and holiday deliveries can cost more.
Does BabyQuip give discounts for longer rentals?
Yes, automatically: 10% off for 9 to 16 days, 20% off for 17 to 24 days and 30% off for 25 days or more.
What is BabyQuip's cancellation policy?

Cancel 15 days or more before the start for a refund of rental fees, minus the service fee. Within 15 days, rental fees aren't refunded, but delivery fees are. The optional Cancel For Any Reason add-on lets you cancel up to the start time.
What is the minimum rental at BabyQuip?
Usually 3 days. Some providers offer 1 or 2 days on request, so ask the provider before you book.
Why isn't my BabyQuip promo code working?

Type {code} exactly, with no spaces, and remove any other code. Check that it's applied to the rental before the service fee is added. If it still won't apply, BabyQuip's support team can check your order.
